reviews.text: Completion makes a determinate result available for consequences which could not travel while the act remained undecided. Leaving everything perpetually undecided would remove the achieved form through which another act can proceed. The native requirement is that completion retain its derivation and revisability, so its local authority can be used without being promoted into possession of the whole.

The comparison therefore has a definite test: identify the norm, the boundary it helps sustain, the perturbation admitted and the loop through which the resulting distinction changes conduct or revises that norm. Return restores access to formation, exclusions and counterfactual alternatives; ending the claim to necessity need not annihilate the acquired competence.

reviews.text: [Qualitative succession, concrescence, biological production, formal re-entry and dynamical modelling](../../../dossiers/process.md) make different transformations available to inquiry. Their changing intellectual objects and inherited constraints help a later account specify what its comparison preserves. In Taylor's [native process](../../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), an achieved form becomes available as another act's means while keeping its rel

The route is not a claim that one school simply replaced another, or that the sequence establishes direct influence at every transition. Medieval theology, nineteenth-century duration, twentieth-century process metaphysics and biological organization, and contemporary computational methods retain distinct questions. Their encounter in the essay makes their differences productive: what does each let a later inquiry determine, and what must that inquiry still supply?
